user.title: Smart Thermostat setup
user.description: Set up a smart thermostat with independent control for heating and cooling.

data.cool_switch: AC switch — used if cooling type is Switch
data.ac_scene_cool_on: AC turn-on scene — used if cooling type is Scene
data.ac_scene_cool_off: AC turn-off scene — used if cooling type is Scene
data.ac_climate_entity: AC climate entity — used if cooling type is Climate Entity
data.ac_climate_min_runtime: AC minimum runtime before turning off (minutes)
data.outdoor_temp_threshold: Outdoor temperature threshold to stop heating (°C)

data_description.thermostat_name: E.g. Living Room Thermostat, Bedroom Thermostat
data_description.temp_sensor: The sensor that measures the room temperature
data_description.heat_switch: The switch that controls the radiator valve
data_description.cool_type: How you control the AC for cooling — a simple switch, on/off scenes (e.g. Tuya IR) or a climate entity (native AC or Tuya IR set up as climate)
data_description.cool_switch: The switch that controls the AC (only relevant if cooling type is Switch)
data_description.ac_climate_cool_temp: The fixed temperature set on the AC every time the thermostat starts cooling
data_description.ac_climate_min_runtime: The AC will not be turned off sooner than this after it started, to protect its compressor (0 = no protection)
data_description.window_sensor: When the window is open, the thermostat stops automatically
data_description.outdoor_sensor: When it is warmer outside than the threshold, heating stops
data_description.hysteresis: Tolerance band around the target temperature (e.g. 0.5 = ±0.5°C)
data_description.outdoor_temp_threshold: Outdoor temperature above which heating is stopped
data_description.temp_step: Step used by the +/− buttons and by dragging on the dial

abort.no_temp_sensors: No temperature sensors were found in Home Assistant.
abort.no_switches: No switches were found in Home Assistant.
